content.intro: This lesson introduces deserialization risks and untrusted data as part of python security and reliability. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: File and data handling should make encoding, paths, data format, permissions, and failure cases explicit. Never deserialize untrusted pickle data.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: File and data handling should make encoding, paths, data format, permissions, and failure cases explicit. Never deserialize untrusted pickle data.

content_blocks.title: Version and reliability note
content_blocks.text: Security-sensitive topics require explicit trust boundaries. Never use pickle for untrusted data, avoid shell command strings built from user input, and do not commit credentials.
